title: Reading related data without hand-writing the wrong join

competitor.concept: Convex has no join operator: a query function reads related data by walking relationships in plain TypeScript — calling ctx.db.get(doc.otherId) to follow a stored id, or ctx.db.query('other').withIndex(...) to look up by a denormalized foreign key — and assembles the joined result by hand inside the function body.

PostgREST resource embedding: a nested select like `.select('*, author:authors(name)')` follows a Postgres foreign-key relationship server-side, with join modifiers (`!inner`, `!left`, explicit FK-name disambiguation) controlling whether the embed filters or preserves the parent row.
